patterns.comment: A line is a comment when its first non-whitespace character is ; or # (tf's own load_file() rule, not just the ;; convention test-case headers use).
patterns.name: comment.line.semicolon.tf

patterns.comment: %{var} — not expanded in a top-level command (load-no-expansion); deferred inside /def, /for, /bind, /hook and /trig-family bodies.
patterns.name: variable.other.tf

patterns.comment: %0-%9 positional argument, %* the rest, %-1 etc. a relative positional range.
patterns.name: variable.parameter.tf

patterns.comment: %; separates commands on one logical line.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.separator.tf

patterns.comment: $[...] — a redundant-inside-/if expression substitution (dollar-bracket-in-if); legal anywhere an expression is read.
patterns.name: variable.other.expression.tf

patterns.comment: A top-level /word: tf's control-flow keywords, C builtins, and stdlib.tf macros are all written the same way.
patterns.name: keyword.control.tf
